parameters.name: PolarFSAccessKeyId
parameters.description: 用户主账号或子账号的AccessKeyID，请确保创建PolarFS实例时已为该主账号/子账号授权

parameters.name: PolarFSAccessKeySecret
parameters.description: 用户主账号或子账号的AccessKeySecret

parameters.name: PolarFSInstanceId
parameters.description:
PolarFS 冷存版实例ID

目前仅如下应用支持冷存版实例
- supabase

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb attach-application-polar-fs --application-id pa-00000000000000 --polar-fs-instance-id pcs-00000000000000 --polar-fs-access-key-id LT0000000000000000000000 --polar-fs-access-key-secret H30000000000000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb AttachApplicationPolarFS --region cn-hangzhou --PolarFSAccessKeyId LT0000000000000000000000 --PolarFSAccessKeySecret H30000000000000000000000000000 --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --PolarFSInstanceId 'pcs-00000000000000'
